messages:
maria_cs: FYI Oxbridge legal reached out requesting onboarding for a custom contract extractor. key asks: redaction of PHI/PII, KV extraction (clauses, effective dates, parties), and multimodal support for scanned PDFs/images. they want private deployment with customer KMS and dedicated GPUs.

sam_se: Got it. Do we have their expected QPS and dataset size? Also need to confirm whether they want real-time (low ms) or batch throughput.

maria_cs: They're aiming for near-real-time. target latency <= 200ms p50 for the extractor end-to-end and p95 < 500ms. expected steady qps ~8, burst 40. dataset ~120k docs, ~60% scanned images. some records contain PHI (redaction required).

leo_eng: 200ms p50 for multimodal OCR + extraction is tight. We'll likely need Dedicated with optimized OCR pipeline + KV-modeling. Can we accept p95 500ms? Also need sample docs and labels to benchmark.

anya_prod: Also flagging account health: renewal in 6 months, adoption is currently low (trial integrations running on dev sandbox). If we miss latency/accuracy targets it becomes a renewal risk. Recommend an enablement workshop for their eng team and a joint success plan.

maria_cs: Agreed on workshop. Oxbridge wants an eval harness and pass/fail criteria that include: redaction_recall >= 0.98, field_f1 >= 0.91, and manual review failure rate < 2%. They've asked for an audit log + explainability for each redaction decision.

sam_se: I'll draft the eval job config. Proposal snippet: 
```json
{
  "eval_name": "oxbridge_contract_kv",
  "metrics": ["redaction_recall","field_f1","redaction_explainability"],
  "latency_slo_ms": 200,
  "qps_target": 8
}
```
Can someone confirm the metric thresholds?

leo_eng: thresholds look reasonable. We'll need to run several quantization candidates and a small canary on Dedicated to validate memory/latency. Also request HSM for key wrapping per their compliance.

maria_cs: Compliance: they require customer-managed KMS + audit trail for decryption operations. They've also asked for a consent workflow for PHI samples during evals.

ops_bot: deploybot: Note: provisioning dedicated_pool_oxbridge will take ~5 business days. Autoscale baseline to 10 GPUs for canary.

anya_prod: Action items: 1) maria_cs to collect 500 labeled sample docs and PHI consent from Oxbridge. 2) sam_se to create eval harness + thresholds. 3) leo_eng to size Dedicated pool and propose quantization presets. 4) schedule enablement + security review with Oxbridge.

maria_cs: I'll ask for the sample data and consent form today. Can we target a sync Tues 10am PT to review the eval results and Dedicated sizing?

sam_se: Tue 10am PT works for me. I'll have the initial harness ready and a small local run to share numbers.

leo_eng: Marked. I'll prepare two candidate runtime configs: fp16 + int8-quantized, and bring rough expected p50/p95 numbers.

anya_prod: I'll draft a renewal-risk mitigation note to include in the customer playbook (workshop deliverables, success metrics, escalation path).

maria_cs: Great — keeping this high priority. Oxbridge asked for a contactable SRE during canary window; can we assign one?

leo_eng: I'll be the on-call SRE for the canary window. ping me in the channel during tests. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll update Oxbridge and post the consent/sample link here when I have it. :thumbsup:
